_readme: QA scenarios for scripts/qaRun.js (founder 2026-09-18). Each turn's `expect` is checked against the stream's metadata and cards; anything not listed is judged by reading the report. Add a scenario for every live incident.

scenarios.why: 2026-09-18: 'near a lake' became Sea Lake, Australia (v2), then Swan Lake pond; v3 must ask, then search the lake's shore, then narrow to luxury.

turns.say: I want to stay near a lake for several days
no, sevan
something luxurious

scenarios.why: 2026-09-18: 'sea/lake' → Google → Sea Lake, Victoria, 13,086 km away; every card must stay in the traveler's region.

turns.say: I want to stay near sea/lake several days

scenarios.why: 2026-09-16 03:00: 'what is open right now' dealt groceries; the vague ask must become one question with choices (v3).

turns.say: what is open right now

scenarios.why: 2026-09-14: 'ok thanks' dealt six more restaurants; a thank-you closes the exchange.

turns.say: find me a good cafe
ok thanks

scenarios.why: 2026-09-13: 'yes please' after a flight offer failed; the answer belongs to the lane that asked.

turns.say: find flight to Moscow next week
yes please

scenarios.why: 2026-09-13: 'stay 4 days' was read as a hotel noun after a flight search.

turns.say: find flight to Moscow next week
I need to stay 4 days

scenarios.why: Founder 2026-09-18: moods must find places — a stated mood is a deck.

turns.say: somewhere quiet to read for an hour

scenarios.why: A mood with no shape gets one question with choices, not six random cards.

turns.say: I'm bored

scenarios.why: 'I want to celebrate tonight' names a mood and a time — a deck by day; near midnight one question (dinner, drinks, a view?) is the better answer, so either is a pass.

turns.say: I want to celebrate tonight

scenarios.why: A how-to question is answered in prose, never with cards ('how do I book a taxi' once returned six museums).

turns.say: how do I get a SIM card in Yerevan

scenarios.why: Price question: the agent should call hotel_prices (liteAPI) and quote only returned numbers; owner-listed prices reach the card as listedPrice.

turns.say: How much is a night in a good hotel on Lake Sevan? Nothing fancy, just clean and quiet.

scenarios.why: Big-city control for the price partner: dated stay in Dubai Marina — separates 'sandbox is thin in Armenia' from 'the call is wrong'.

turns.say: I'll be in Dubai Marina on 10-12 October, what does a decent 4-star hotel cost per night there?

scenarios.why: Europe, budget ask in French: the tool should price central Paris and the model should quote only returned numbers, in French.

turns.say: Je cherche un hôtel pas cher près du Louvre pour le week-end prochain, ça coûte combien la nuit ?

scenarios.why: Asia, luxury with dates: the range (cheapest/median/priciest) should let the model say what luxury means in Bangkok.

turns.say: Luxury hotel in Bangkok on the river, 20-23 November — what would a night cost me?

scenarios.why: Neighbouring country, no dates, no style: default stay + honest 'no availability' or real prices.

turns.say: Weekend in Tbilisi old town, any good hotel and roughly how much?

scenarios.why: Founder's own ask (style luxury, interest romantic): only DATED events may be dealt — a venue with 'check its schedule' is padding; posters should be present.

turns.say: suggest events please for the upcoming days with my girlfriend

scenarios.why: Big city with 9 registered sources: weekend events with posters and times.

turns.say: what's on in Dubai this weekend?

scenarios.why: Neighbour with thinner coverage: honest 'few/none' beats padding with venues.

turns.say: any concerts or festivals in Tbilisi next week?

scenarios.why: French ask in a city that may have no registered source: the reply must not invent events.

turns.say: Il y a quoi comme événements à Paris ce week-end ?
